defect.summary: The hash-chained stores skip whitespace-only lines when reading (append-store.ts:278 and the same filter in ledger.ts:287, floor-trail.ts:544, notice-log.ts:356). A file with an inserted blank line still verifies, and a writer extends it afterwards. For a store whose claim is tamper-evidence, ignored bytes are the defect itself. Found by the cold verifier on Act A (VERIFY_ActA-Chained-Subject-Log_20260923); the glue instance (subject-event-journal.ts:509) was fixed in acta-repair; T4 makes the core stores match. Fix: no line is skipped; a reader that meets a whitespace-only or malformed line reports a torn chain and does not verify; a writer refuses to append after one. One rule, all four stores.

arbiter.word: I open the core for the stores' blank-line hole, because a chain that ignores bytes is not a chain. One rule for every store: nothing is skipped. Close the door on the 29th.

conditions: NO frozen set is opened. verdict-logic.frozen.json, verdict-logic.substrate-snapshot.json AND verdict-logic.frozen.pre-substrate-20260819.json stay byte-identical; the proof is the UNCHANGED sha256 of each file against its pin in core-inventory.json at T4's start — never a green snapshot test.

The five test files are opened ONLY to change the pins that assert the old skip behaviour (append-store.test.ts's deliberate pin and its false comment; chokepoint.test.ts :924 and :972; floor-trail.test.ts :816 and :864; doctor.test.ts :1188 and :1236) and to ADD refusal checks. No other assertion changes.  Renaming a check's TITLE string is not an assertion change (AMENDED 2026-09-23 by Frank).

Pre-registration before any code, per store: a valid chain with one inserted blank line reads VERIFIED before and TORN/refused after; the clean twin is unchanged before and after; a writer's append after a blank line is refused after. One killed mutant per store that reintroduces the skip.
Cold verifier before relay. The shipping commit re-pins every file it changed (npm run core-door -- --propose-repin T4-store-blank-lines). One change per relay: T4 relays AFTER T3 is on the box.
